h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturers in Surat

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturers in Surat

items.pText: A Surat builder selling flats in a new tower wants a play area that looks good on the brochure. It also has to hold up to daily use once residents move in. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for these projects, and for schools and gardens, at our factory in Vasai East, about 200 km away down the coast.

Surat is known for diamond cutting and textiles, and new residential towers keep coming up across the city. It is humid, close to the sea and gets a heavy monsoon from June to September. Share your amenity plan, the size of the play area and the age group you expect. We will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, ready for your architect.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

items.pText: We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.
We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.
We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.
Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

items.q: Do you work with builders and architects in Surat?
items.a: Yes. We send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, which your architect can place on the amenity plan. Colours and some design details can be customised.

items.q: Do you have themed playground equipment?
items.a: Yes. Castle Crest, Robo Romp, Clown Capade and Forestia are themed CoreCraft ranges, and Funplay Originals are designed by our own team.

items.q: How far is your factory from Surat?
items.a: Our factory is in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 200 km from Surat. We deliver by road, and our own team or a local dealer installs the equipment.
